raw_comment:
I Notice that droughts are more concentrated in the Middle and southern parts of the United States. In the south, there are the most extreme droughts in the United States. 

I wonder if the droughts will spread further to the east and west and how this will affect other States. 

This affects me and my community because if the droughts worsen in Perth Amboy, this could impact the use of water, leading to restrictions on the use of water in houses. Perth Amboy could also face higher prices, which would affect many low-income families. 

Headline: "From Coast to Coast: Tracking Droughts Across the U.S."
